Kratom Head
I have been using Kratom for about a year now.  I would like to say that although it is very fun and can be a great mood enhancer, it is very addictive for me.  Both physically and mentally.  I take it every day alomost and have to take up to 10 grams to have an effect now.  I have tried to stop taking it and a day or two after my last dose I get really restless, cramp up, and have horrible stomach problems.  In general I just feel like shit when I am not on Kratom.  Although legal, this substance is a drug and is addictive. I am not saying that I don't like it but I am addicted to it and probably need help to stop.  I have done this to myself and wish their was a way just to quit cold turkey.  Another negative thing is the price.  I don't know how much money I have spent on it but I would probably have quite a nest-egg if I had all that money back.  I just wanted to say that although Kratom is one of my favorite substances, the addiction to it is pretty dammnning.  Thanks for listening.
